About Shippo

At Shippo, our vision is bold and clear: we are the shipping layer of the internet. Our mission is to make every merchant successful through excellent shipping, delivering world-class logistics technology and infrastructure. We’re building the backbone of global e-commerce — connecting merchants to carriers worldwide through a single API and intuitive dashboard.

As a remote-first and globally distributed team, we believe flexibility fuels trust, autonomy, and performance. Our diverse perspectives — across continents, cultures, and time zones — drive our innovation and enable us to build solutions used by businesses everywhere. We invest in modern, scalable technology so our teams can build, ship, and iterate with confidence.

Your impact starts here: every person at Shippo plays a direct role in shaping the infrastructure that powers global commerce and makes shipping simpler for businesses around the world.

How we will deliver success together:

As a Finance Manager, Strategic Finance, you will own the financial backbone of Shippo: the full company P&L, the annual operating plan, monthly C-level reporting, and board-level financial materials. This is not a support role. You will be the primary financial operator for a high-growth logistics technology company, accountable for the numbers that the CEO, CFO, and Board rely on.

This role carries meaningful executive exposure. You will report directly to the VP of Strategic Finance and have a skip-level relationship with the CFO, meaning your work will be seen, challenged, and relied upon at the top of the organization. You will produce the quarterly Board of Directors finance addendum, present financials in monthly leadership reviews, and be a trusted voice in the room when the numbers matter most. For the right person, this is a fast path to genuine strategic influence.

You will work directly with the CFO (as your skip level), and partner with Accounting, People Ops, and Engineering, and the full leadership team. The right person for this role is a strong finance operator who thrives on ownership, thinks commercially, and isn't satisfied just reporting the numbers - they want to understand them, improve them, and communicate them to decision-makers who act on them.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

Company P&L & Close Reporting

  • Own the full company P&L, revenue through EBITDA, and serve as the primary finance partner to Accounting for the monthly close cycle.
  • Produce the monthly MBR (Monthly Business Review), flash report, and supporting financial narrative for senior leadership, translating actuals vs. plan into clear stories and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the Controller to ensure accuracy and alignment on actuals and variances vs. plan.

Annual Operating Plan & Forecasting

  • Own the Master P&L model, the company's single source of truth for forecasting, scenario analysis, and AOP. Build, maintain, and evolve it as the business changes.
  • Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process across all functions, including headcount planning, cost modeling, and revenue scenario builds.
  • Drive 2-3 reforecasts throughout the year, surfacing risks and opportunities before they show up in actuals.

Board & Executive Reporting

  • Produce the quarterly Board of Directors Finance Addendum, including financial exhibits, variance analysis, and supplemental data packages reviewed by the CFO and CEO.
  • Build the financial models and materials that support executive decision-making on product investment and cost savings strategies.

Transaction Readiness & M&A Support

  • Own and maintain Shippo's transaction readiness infrastructure, auditable P&L and balance sheet flat files, Looker cohort and retention views, AR/AP aging standardization, ensuring the company is 80%+ deal-ready at any given time.
  • Serve as the internal financial lead for any M&A diligence process, managing the data room and coordinating with Legal, Accounting, and the CFO on financial workstreams.

Headcount & Cost Management

  • Partner with People Ops as the finance counterpart to headcount planning, managing req approvals and monthly HC reporting for the exec team and Board.
  • Own the R&D and cross-functional HC scenario modeling tools used by the CTO and CMO, and maintain the financial view of headcount by department.
  • Lead recurring software and infrastructure cost reviews (AWS, SaaS vendors) with technical and operational stakeholders to drive efficiency.
  • Own vendor contract audits, identifying and actioning lapsed or suboptimal contracts.

Strategic Analysis & Ad Hoc

  • Build investment briefs, pro formas, and carrier/partner sizing models to support strategic decisions, including carrier economics, new product monetization, and geographic expansion.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales Finance on go-to-market financial modeling.
  • Drive improvements in FP&A tooling, data integrity, and financial systems to support scalable growth.

Your shipping requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in financial planning & analysis, corporate finance, or strategic finance, with at least 2 years in a high-growth technology or SaaS company. Investment banking, private equity, or M&A advisory background is a plus.
  • Experience owning a full company or business unit P&L, not just a function or cost center, and navigating the ambiguity that comes with it.
  • Exposure to transaction processes (M&A, capital raise, or strategic review) and familiarity with financial due diligence data packages.
  • Expert-level financial modeling skills: multi-driver operating models, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and headcount planning models.
  • Strong proficiency in NetSuite and at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or Power BI). Comfort with Rippling or similar HRIS is a plus.
  • Strong commercial instincts: you don't just explain the variance, you explain what it means for the business and what we should do about it.
  • Highly organized and reliable - business partners, the CFO, and the CEO depend on you to get this right, on time, every time.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related. MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus but not required.

What is in the Shippo Package?

  • Healthcare coverage for medical, dental, and vision (90% covered by the company, incl. dependents). Pets coverage is also available!
  • Take-as-much-as-you-need vacation policy & flexible working hours
  • One week-long company wide winter slow down
  • 3 Volunteer Days Off (VTOs)
  • WFH stipend to set up your home office
  • Charity donation match up to $100
  • Dedicated programs, coaching, tools, and resources for your professional and career growth as well as an individual learning stipend for your personal and focused growth
  • Fun team in person time through our Shippos Everywhere program which includes regular team and company off-sites throughout the year as well as local Shippos gatherings

Compensation

Our Compensation Shippolicy:

We believe compensation is a custom experience and are commited to fair and equitable compensation practices. The standard base pay range for this role is min is $136,000.00 to a max $184,000.00 annual salary (we tend to anchor our offers at the mid point $160,000.00. Since we are focused on hiring Shippos Everywhere, we have 2 US pay ranges, a standard compensation range for the majority of the US and a standard +1 compensation range for those who live in areas where the cost of labor is higher, such as NYC and California.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: financial budgets, work experience, training, transferable skills, business needs, and market value. The base pay salary ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. Total compensation for this role will include, equity, medical, dental, vision and other benefits noted in our Shippos “package” section.

Sail through the process:

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

Shippos in the wild:

Our people, much like the packages we help ship, are all over the world. This means, through our remote-first program, “Shippos Everywhere”, our roles can be based anywhere in the US with the exception of Delaware, Nevada, Ohio, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico and West Virginia and many roles can be based internationally.

For locations outside of the US and Ireland, the employment contracts are powered by Rippling.com.

We are looking for a Finance Director to lead the financial operations of Devsu, while acting as a strategic partner to leadership.

This is not a traditional accounting role. You will act as a senior financial leader, owning financial visibility, planning, and decision support across the company, and serving as a key partner to leadership in shaping the business.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring financial accuracy and helping shape the financial direction of the business, balancing execution with strategy. Position is 100% remote in Ecuador and LATAM.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Financial Operations & Compliance

  • Own the monthly close process across entities.
  • Oversee preparation of:
    • Balance Sheet
    • Profit & Loss (P&L)
    • Cash flow statements
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • Ecuadorian accounting, tax, and labor regulations (primary)
    • U.S. GAAP
  • Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, and tax advisors in both, US and Ecuador jurisdictions.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
  • Build and maintain financial models to support growth decisions.
  • Provide insights on:
    • Profitability by client / service line.
    • Cost structure and margin optimization.
    • Cash flow and capital allocation.
  • Support leadership in strategic initiatives (pricing, expansion, efficiency).
  • Identify risks and opportunities proactively.

Business Optimization

  • Design and implement cost control and financial discipline frameworks.
  • Improve financial processes, reporting clarity, and internal controls through automation and AI.
  • Support cross-border structure optimization and tax efficiency (in coordination with advisors).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in finance/accounting roles, with increasing responsibility.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Ecuadorian accounting and tax regulations (required).
    • U.S. GAAP (working knowledge required).
  • Experience managing multi-entity or international financial operations.
  • Proven experience in financial planning, modeling, and analysis (FP&A).
  • Strong business acumen—ability to connect numbers to decisions.
  • Advanced Excel / financial modeling skills.
  • Fluent in Spanish and English.

Nice to Have (Bonus Points)

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration with a concentration in Finance, or equivalent advanced degree.
  • Experience in company valuations (DCF, comparables, transaction support).
  • Background in software / tech services companies.
  • Experience supporting executive teams or founders directly.
  • Exposure to M&A, fundraising, or financial structuring.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who:

  • Thinks like an owner, not just an accountant.
  • Is comfortable operating with ambiguity and autonomy.
  • Can challenge assumptions with data and logic.
  • Balances attention to detail with big-picture thinking.
  • Wants to grow into a future CFO role.

Benefits

Why This Role

This is an opportunity to step into a high-impact finance leadership role within a growing, international company without the bureaucracy of a traditional corporate environment.

You’ll work directly with leadership, influence key decisions, and help build the financial foundation for the next stage of growth.

VP Finance

Who We Are

At Voltify, we are building the next generation of rail: battery locomotives that fast charge autonomously and dynamically through a dedicated self-sustained microgrid network.

We are bringing back the power to the industry and eliminating the dependency on fossil fuels, lowering the rail industry’s main expense, energy, by more than 20%. This is over $3B yearly just in North America.

We are already working with some of the largest global rail companies with over $50M in contingent orders. We have raised over $50M from top tier funds and strategics and are rapidly growing.

Our founding team has a proven track record in building billion dollar public companies in renewable energy and infrastructure.

The Opportunity

Voltify sells railroads a complete energy system as a service: battery locomotives, charging, and our own microgrids. Railroads cut their biggest cost without spending capital. Voltify owns the assets and the recurring revenue.

That makes us an infrastructure company, an energy company, and a technology company at once. Here, finance is the growth engine, not a support function. How we fund each locomotive, charger, and microgrid sets how fast we grow, what we earn, and what our capital costs.

Battery rail has never been financed at scale. Our VP Finance will write the playbook.

What You’ll Own

  • Capital. Equity funding.
  • Asset finance. The structures that fund our fleet and energy network: project finance, tax equity, lease facilities, and infrastructure partnerships. Hundreds of millions of dollars, then billions.
  • Deal design. Pricing and contract structures (leasing, energy sales, hybrids) that win customers and attract capital.
  • The model. One financial model linking engineering, deployment, unit economics, and capital.
  • Public readiness. Audit, controls, governance, and investor relations built to public company standards from day one.
  • Incentives. Every tax credit, grant, and public financing program we qualify for.
  • The team. A lean, AI-native finance organization across accounting, FP&A, treasury, and tax.
  • Legal - leading our GC and soon in-house counsel and all contracts.
  • Payments - leading out day to day financial operations

Great to have

  • You’ve raised billions in equity and debt, in good markets and bad.
  • You’ve financed long-lived, capital intensive assets in energy, utilities, telecom, transportation, infrastructure, or real estate.
  • You’ve financed something no one had financed before.
  • Boards, banks, and investors have backed you, and would again.
  • You can make a complex capital structure clear to a banker, a board, and an engineer.
  • You’d rather build than maintain. Hands on, low ego, fast.
  • Rail, transportation, or energy experience is a plus.

Senior Account Executive | Aesthetic Equipment Finance

Altius Search Group is recruiting for a Senior Account Executive | Aesthetic Equipment Finance position for one of our clients in the equipment finance industry. This position focuses on originating and developing financing opportunities across the aesthetic, medical spa, dermatology, plastic surgery, and wellness equipment markets.

A successful candidate will have proven experience in originating equipment finance transactions or in selling capital equipment to the aesthetic industry. Ideal candidates will have relationships with aesthetic equipment manufacturers, distributors, dealers, medical spa operators, dermatology practices, plastic surgery groups, wellness clinics, and other healthcare-related end users that purchase high-value aesthetic equipment.

Our client is an equipment finance company that partners with equipment vendors, manufacturers, dealers, and direct end users to provide attractive financing solutions. The role will focus on developing and managing vendor finance relationships, originating new business, structuring transactions, and managing the sales process from prospecting through funding.

Typical equipment may include aesthetic lasers, body contouring systems, RF microneedling devices, IPL platforms, hair removal systems, skin rejuvenation equipment, tattoo removal systems, facial treatment platforms, wellness equipment, and related medical spa technology.

Knowledge / Skills Required

  • Origination of small- to mid-ticket equipment finance transactions within the aesthetic, med-spa, dermatology, healthcare, or specialty equipment markets.

  • Develop and maintain vendor leasing and finance programs with qualified aesthetic equipment manufacturers, distributors, dealers, and resellers.

  • Work directly with vendors and their customers to structure and present financing products for a variety of aesthetic and medical spa equipment.

  • Manage transactions from application through funding, including coordination with vendors, customers, credit, documentation, and internal operations teams.

  • Originate new vendor and end-user relationships while managing and growing existing accounts.

  • Understand financing structures, including equipment finance agreements, leases, loans, deferred payment options, promotional programs, and vendor-driven financing solutions.

  • Negotiate lease terms, pricing, transaction structure, and financing options with vendors and end users.

  • Facilitate the gathering of credit information for underwriting and support a smooth transaction process.

  • Provide front-line sales support for financial products to manufacturers, distributors, dealers, equipment resellers, and healthcare business owners.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the aesthetic equipment marketplace, including vendor sales cycles, equipment costs, customer buying behavior, and financing needs.

Essential Job Functions

  • Market equipment finance solutions to aesthetic equipment vendors, manufacturers, distributors, dealers, medical spas, dermatology practices, plastic surgery practices, wellness centers, and other qualified end users.

  • Develop new vendor relationships through outbound calls, referrals, industry networking, trade shows, marketing campaigns, and direct outreach.

  • Support existing manufacturer and vendor programs by following up on financing opportunities, managing active transactions, and strengthening vendor engagement.

  • Partner with aesthetic equipment sales representatives to help them close equipment sales by providing financing options to their customers.

  • Structure financing solutions that help customers acquire revenue-generating aesthetic equipment while supporting vendor sales growth.

  • Expedite ongoing transactions by coordinating with credit, documentation, funding, vendors, and lessees.

  • Facilitate prompt payment of vendor invoices and monitor customer service levels to vendors and borrowers.

  • Maintain an active pipeline of vendor and end-user opportunities and consistently work toward production goals.

  • Represent the company professionally in the aesthetic equipment finance marketplace.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant sales experience in equipment finance, vendor finance, medical equipment finance, healthcare finance, or aesthetic capital equipment sales.

  • Prior experience in financing or selling aesthetic, medical spa, dermatology, plastic surgery, laser, wellness, or related healthcare equipment is strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of the aesthetic equipment marketplace and the role financing plays in helping vendors sell equipment.

  • Existing relationships with aesthetic equipment manufacturers, dealers, distributors, or end users are highly desirable.

  • A firm grasp of the advantages of financing for both the customer and the targeted vendor.

  • Highly competent in sales, negotiating, relationship-building, and closing skills.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding production, revenue, or sales goals.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote sales environment and achieve established objectives.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with vendors, business owners, credit teams, and documentation teams.

  • Comfortable managing a full sales cycle from prospecting to funding.

Preferred Backgrounds

  • Aesthetic equipment finance sales.

  • Medical equipment finance sales.

  • Vendor finance or manufacturer finance programs.

  • Healthcare equipment leasing.

  • Capital equipment sales within the aesthetic, dermatology, plastic surgery, or medical spa industry.

  • Sales experience with aesthetic device manufacturers, laser companies, wellness technology companies, or specialty medical equipment providers.

Compensation

Competitive base salary plus incentive compensation. Compensation will be commensurate with experience, production history, existing relationships, and overall fit for the role.

Work Location

Remote position with a focus on the West Coast and Western U.S. markets. Candidates located in California, Oregon, Washington, Arizona, Nevada, Utah, Idaho, Colorado, or surrounding markets are encouraged to apply.

Highlights

Franchsie Finance - Leading vendor program growth, originating small–mid ticket deals, structuring financing, and managing full lifecycle from prospecting to funding.

Management Partners is seeking a seasoned municipal finance expert to assist our clients in the Pacific Northwest and nationwide on a part-time basis.

Management Partners is a professional management consulting firm that helps local governments increase their effectiveness by analyzing operations and recommending improvements. As a company we value diversity, intelligence, curiosity, and initiative. And a sense of humor. Founded in 1994, our staff includes managers with practical experience in public service in a variety of program areas. We understand how to bring excellence to public service, and we are sensitive to the political context in which public services are provided. Our clients include cities, counties, and special districts of all sizes across the United States.

Ideal candidates will

  • Have served as a Finance Director/Chief Financial Officer in a local government agency (city, county, or special district)
  • Possess significant knowledge of local government finance, accounting, budget, and financial operations
  • Have a desire in performing project-related work and sharing their finance skills in serving communities on a part-time basis, as needed
  • Effectively work in a remote environment, with travel optional

Management Partners welcomes PERS retirees (e.g., WA-PERS, OR-PERS, CalPERS).

At Management Partners, we introduce innovation, ideas, and fresh perspectives into local government. Our consultants help cities, counties and other public agencies articulate complex issues and analyze systems in a simple straightforward way so that problems can be understood, and solutions developed and implemented. It is hard to make complexity simple but good analytics is always the key. It’s public service management consulting that makes a difference.

Management Partners has offices in San Jose and Costa Mesa, California, and in Cincinnati, Ohio, although all consulting associates can and do work remotely. More information about the firm can be found at Management Partners. As a Special Advisor for the organization, the candidate will work with consultants based throughout the United States.

Finance Reinvention Associate Director

We are looking for a commercially sharp, deeply experienced Finance Practitioner to lead Finance Reinvention for Fortune 500 clients. You will combine domain mastery in F&A with fluency in AI, agentic technologies, and modern ERP ecosystems — driving deals from origination through wins and building lasting CFO and CAO level relationships. This is a senior client-facing role for someone who can sell, shape, and deliver large-scale transformation in equal measure.

What You Will Do

  • Lead F&A Sales and Practice — Own the full deal lifecycle from pursuit and origination through shaping, oral presentations, workshops, co-design, and project execution for global enterprise clients.

  • Drive CFO-level relationships — Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, CAOs, and Finance leadership, influencing strategy and generating new opportunities through insight and credibility.

  • Design AI-first Finance solutions — Apply agentic AI, intelligent automation, and emerging ERP and ecosystem technologies to reinvent F&A operating models, with clear value outcomes at the centre of every design decision.

  • Shape compelling value propositions — Translate complex transformation programme into commercially clear narratives that win client CFO confidence and close large-scale managed services deals.

  • Deliver deep domain expertise — Act as a recognised specialist in at least one F&A tower (PTP, OTC, RTR, or FP&A), leading process re-engineering, digital transformation, and AI integration within that domain.

  • Set the thought leadership agenda — Contribute to market-facing points of view on Finance Reinvention, AI in F&A, and the future of the Finance function; elevate the firm's presence at industry forums.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, and CPA or equivalent

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in large-scale Finance Sales or transformation experience in consulting or Managed Services.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in Insurance, Banking or capital markets

Preferred

  • CPA certified

  • Previous external consulting experience

  • Proven track record leading and closing large Finance consulting or managed services deals

  • Demonstrated AI fluency — able to design and articulate AI-first operating models, not just reference AI concepts

  • Hands-on experience deploying agentic AI, GenAI, or intelligent automation in a Finance context

  • Deep familiarity with leading ERP and F&A platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Coupa, etc.)

  • Industry expertise in Financial industry eg Banking, Insurance

  • Experience structuring and winning F&A managed services contracts
